'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**[[Drone warfare|Drones]] and rockets strike the [[Al-Asad Airbase]] in [[Al Anbar Governorate]], [[Iraq]], which houses [[U.S.]] troops. [https://www.reuters.com/world/rockets-drones-hit-iraqi-base-housing-us-forces-security-sources-2023-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***A member of the [[Security Cabinet of Israel]] says that the [[Israel Defense Forces]] has been given the "green light" to enter the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/live-updates/israel-gaza-live-updates/israeli-military-has-green-light-to-move-into-gaza-official-says-104133249?id=104049894 (ABC News)]
**Five [[Palestinians]] are killed in clashes with the Israeli military at the [[Nur Shams|Nur Shams refugee camp]] in [[Tulkarm]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/five-palestinians-killed-west-bank-clashes-with-israeli-forces-ministry-2023-10-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***Dozens of rockets are fired at the [[Northern District (Israel)|northern]] [[Israeli cities]] of [[Nahariya]] and [[Kiryat Shmona]] from [[southern Lebanon]], injuring at least three [[civilian]]s. [[Hamas]] says that its [[Clandestine cell system|cells]] in [[Lebanon]] were responsible for the rocket attacks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-shells-southern-lebanon-after-missiles-fired-at-border-community/ (The Times of Israel)]
***[[Israel]] responds with [[airstrike]]s on [[Hezbollah]] positions and [[Lebanese Armed Forces]]  claims that the IDF injured three Iranian journalists although Tehran denies the claims. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-shells-southern-lebanon-after-missiles-fired-at-border-community/ (The Times of Israel)]
***[[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL peacekeepers]] claims that one civilian was killed from caught in a cross-fire at the border in when the Lebanese Army requested UNIFIL assistance.[https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231019-un-says-one-killed-in-cross-border-fire-in-south-lebanon (Frane24)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Khatumo State|Khatumo]] is reestablished as one of the federal states of [[Somalia]] by the Somali government. [https://horseedmedia.net/somali-federal-government-recognizes-new-ssc-khatumo-administration-383891 (Horseed Media)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**In the [[Red Sea]], the [[United States Navy]] destroyer [[USS Carney|USS ''Carney'']] uses [[RIM-66 Standard|SM-2 missile]]s to shoot down three [[cruise missile]]s and eight drones launched by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces in [[Yemen]]. [[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] says that the missiles and drones were "potentially headed towards Israel". [https://news.yahoo.com/gma/us-navy-destroyer-red-sea-185700181.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–24 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Babet]] impacts the [[United Kingdom]], bringing [[Gale|gale force winds]] and heavy rains, killing two people in [[Angus, Scotland]], and another person in [[Shropshire]], [[England]]. The crew of a [[Denmark|Danish]] [[fishing trawler]] is rescued by the [[Royal National Lifeboat Institution|RNLI]] in the [[North Sea]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-scotland-67163882 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–India relations]]
**[[Canada]] withdraws 41 diplomats from [[India]] due to India's decision to revoke the diplomats' [[diplomatic immunity|immunity]] following the death of [[Sikh]] [[Khalistan movement|independence]] leader [[Hardeep Singh Nijjar]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/canada-forced-to-repatriate-41-diplomats-from-india-foreign-minister-4498288 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–United Kingdom relations]]
***[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] visits [[Israel]] and meets with [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], announcing the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s solidarity with Israel in its war with [[Hamas]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-67151404 (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**[[Israel]] withdraws its [[List of ambassadors of Israel to Turkey|ambassador]] [[Irit Lillian]] and other diplomats from [[Turkey]] after urging its citizens to avoid all travel to the country. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-769291 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
